heading: Arms and ammunition: immunity from taxation
lead: No tax on the sale or transfer of firearms, pistols, revolvers, shells, or cartridges may be imposed on such articles when bought with funds appropriated for a military department.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 23855:171w.Jan. 6, 1951, ch. 1213, subch. VII, § 706, 64 Stat. 1236. The words “No * * * may be” are substituted for the words “None * * * shall be subject to any”. The words “by any Act” are omitted as surplusage.
